features.title: Discover Agents and workspace peers
features.summary: List live Agents with their title, parent and relation to the caller, related and same-workspace peers first. Nothing subscribes an Agent automatically: the direct inbox needs no registration, and a hashed workspace topic is an explicit opt-in that is pruned once no live Agent works there for a day.
failureModes: A missing workspace cwd cannot derive a workspace topic.
A workspace topic hashes cwd and is not a DSH Workspace registry id or a JJ workspace/revision id.
No Agent is auto-subscribed to a workspace topic; a subscription is an explicit opt-in and the generated channels of older versions are pruned at startup.
The listing carries title, status, parent Session id and relation only; it contains no task text, transcript content or path.
For an Agent's own parent or children, native send_message and subagent results are the channel; the peer tools serve separate top-level threads.
Task-board access remains available only through existing Agent Teams tools to Team members; arbitrary non-Team child task state is not exposed.
An Agent absent from the live registry is not assumed to be complete.

verification.testName: prunes a generated workspace topic once no live Agent remains and it has been idle past the window

projects labels and caller relationships with useful peers first

features.title: Durable peer mail with a bounded request wake
features.summary: Topic and direct messages remain durable records; explicit Agent reads record read time without acknowledging. A direct request additionally wakes an idle recipient through a plugin-source pointer message, under a cooldown and an hourly cap, while every notice and topic message stays passive.

configuration.constraints: A direct request wakes an idle recipient with a pointer message; notices stay passive. Turn it off for passive mail only.

failureModes: Peer text remains untrusted data: a wake carries a pointer to the inbox, never the message body.
A stale cursor requires refreshing the conversation.
Only direct requests wake; notices and topic messages never start, resume, or redirect an Agent.

Wakes are suppressed by a per-recipient cooldown (a burst shares one turn), an undirected pair cooldown (a reply cannot bounce straight back), and an hourly cap; a failure to wake leaves the stored mail for the next turn.
A dedupeKey is scoped to one sender and one target; reusing it for a different target stores a new message.
A completed recipient stays completed; a stored notice is read only during a later natural execution.

onboarding.firstAction: Open Agents › Messages and post a message to a topic.
onboarding.doneWhen: Your message shows in the topic's history.

A: two active agents share information without redirecting either conversation
B: a message to a completed agent stays durable and never resumes or replays it
C: orchestrator inspection is read-only and never resumes the inspected agents
D: a request intent is distinguishable from a notice and still never delegates work
E: concurrent senders keep ordering, attribution, and idempotent retries
F: stale ids and reopened state neither lose messages nor replay them as new instructions
G: a completed workspace agent is not reopened to gather integration context

features.title: Post messages from the communication browser
features.summary: A human can seed a topic or send a direct message; the UI receives a storage receipt and does not inject work into an Agent.
reachNarrow: click button "Agents Configured agents and their messages."
failureModes: Invalid or ambiguous targets are rejected.
A successful post may have zero captured recipients.

verification.testName: browses pages without reading or acknowledging and posts as a browser principal

features.title: Read and acknowledge direct messages
features.summary: Messages survive service reopen, explicit inbox reads do not acknowledge, and only the recipient can acknowledge its record.
failureModes: A message recipient mismatch cannot acknowledge another Agent's message.
Legacy notifications are discarded during passive-delivery migration.
